angle: Movement translation: the same first-1.5 s speed profile built from each player's Combine clip (combine_frames) and his random NFL snaps (game_frames_sample) on the matched movement; does the drill-to-game mismatch explain production beyond pick? Five-group screen, DL (40 start vs NFL pass rush) chosen as clearest.
metric_name: Get-Off Translation (yards): NFL yards covered in the first 1.0 s after the snap on random pass rushes (alignment-adjusted) minus the yards predicted from his Combine 40 start (first 1.0 s after onset, year-adjusted) by a cohort OLS
headline_number: 40 start ranks NFL get-off at only 0.08 [-0.16, 0.31] vs a reliability ceiling of 0.59 (n=67); translation vs pressure rate partial rho 0.31 [-0.05, 0.54] beyond pick, weight, EDGE share, class (n=52), about 1.0 pressure/season per sd [-0.3, 2.1] (80%: 0.2-1.7) vs 1.5 for pick 100->30; out-of-class R2 change -0.083 [-0.530, 0.162]; NFL half alone 0.33, translation beyond NFL half -0.09; five-group family-wise p 0.36.
what_changed_from_previous: New candidate on the translation angle (closest prior: round_05/cand_3 Carry-Over, 7.01). (1) Drill side is the reliable 40 start (rep-to-rep 0.40, mean 0.52) instead of the pass-rush drill (0.12), answering the 'divides by a 0.04-reliability drill' flaw; (2) NFL side is snap-anchored and validated against official NGS get-off (play-level -0.71, season -0.51) with split-half reliability 0.67; (3) a five-cell screen (one metric per group) replaces the 27-cell screen; (4) literal curve-shape similarity is tested and shown uninformative (median 0.961); (5) the lede states one result, the planning number and the null out-of-class test in under 80 words, with one planning number used throughout; (6) the hero figure comes first with its takeaway in the caption; (7) a named top-5/bottom-5 board plus 6-player trace panels and an explicit 'fast in Indianapolis, slow on Sundays' cue (1 of 8 beat forecast); (8) 1,843 words by check.py (1,932 by wc), 5 figures + 1 table, every decimal written by analysis.py, which runs in about 40 s.
open_risks: Headline is a lead, not a forecast: in-sample interval includes zero, out-of-class R2 change is negative (-0.083) and positive in only 25% of bootstraps
Translation adds nothing beyond the NFL get-off itself (-0.09); judges may see it as a re-labelled NGS get-off, and the angle's 'beyond pick' question is answered mostly 'no'
Within-class rho declines 0.49 -> 0.25 -> 0.09 (2025 n=10); 17 DL who skipped the 40 are excluded
Combine side is onset-aligned (no snap) while NFL side is snap-aligned, so translation includes snap reaction by design
No blockers or ball in the game sample: a slow get-off cannot be separated from an early double team; DL is best of five groups (family-wise p 0.36)
